Prompt.txt
Copy this

The scene prompt I gave the agent

Build a 3D blockout scene for a single 6 second car stunt shot. Keep all geometry simple and readable, clay grey materials only, no textures. 1. Road: straight two lane desert highway, 8 m wide, with a painted centre line and gravel shoulders. 2. Canyon: a river canyon crossing the road, 24 m wide, rocky walls dropping down to the water. 3. Drawbridge: a small rural steel bascule bridge with two leaves, each raised 20 degrees, leaving an open gap of about 5 m between the tips. Truss railings on both sides. 4. A small operator hut and a lowered barrier arm before the bridge. 5. Wooden telephone poles every 40 m with sagging wires, low rolling desert hills in the distance. 6. Hero car: a boxy early 1970s four door sedan. Truck: an old tanker truck chasing it. The car breaks through the barrier, launches off the left leaf, flies over the gap and lands on the far bank, then drives away. Add a camera that follows the whole move with smooth, natural motion.
